meta.title: Manga translation workflow
meta.description: Local OCR for marked manga text, GPU de-text and Chinese embedding. Adds a sidebar workbench (start page, native folder picker, async workflow buttons, web box marker, settings and help pages) plus an auto-detection benchmark. Settings cover the vision model/API used for image reading and toggles for the sidebar entry, readiness banner and path memory. Provides the manga_ocr, manga_embed, manga_status and manga_bench tools.
